entities.note: green diamonds (4x4 minus the corners) on floor cells, moved by clicks: rows 18-21 at cols 17-20, 23-26 and 35-38 (board cells (1,2),(2,2),(4,2)), rows 24-27 cols 41-44 (cell (5,3)) and rows 36-39 cols 41-44 (cell (5,5)); a peg jumps 2 cells (12 px) over a neighbour

4x4 colour-1 squares on a 6-px pitch separated by black(0) gutters: a T-shaped board of 7x3 cells (rows 11-28, cols 10-52; cell (gx,gy) at rows 6+6gy..9+6gy, cols 11+6gx..14+6gx) plus a 3-wide stem of 4 more rows (rows 29-52, cols 34-52, cells gx 4-6); pegs may only land on empty floor cells
1-px colour-5 border around the board with a colour-9 drop shadow one pixel right and below; not interactive
colour-10 background outside the board (rows 1-63); clicking it only deselects and plays a hint pointer
none at start; a 6x6 hollow colour-3 ring drawn around the currently selected peg's cell

none at start; after a peg is selected, a small 4-px colour-2 diamond outline is drawn on every floor cell exactly 2 cells away (up/down/left/right) whose intermediate cell holds a peg and which is itself empty; clicking one performs the jump
row 0: black at start, fills with colour 1 from the LEFT one pixel per action (clicks, arrows and undos all advance the visible bar); the hidden budget is 64 actions, undo gives them back

rules.note: the clicked peg becomes the selected one (colour-3 ring appears around it); costs 1
colour-2 markers appear on each legal landing cell two cells away over an adjacent peg; a peg with no legal jump only wiggles
the selected peg jumps two cells (12 px) to the clicked marker; ring and markers are cleared; costs 1

the peg that was jumped over is removed (capture); landing on cells (0,2), (2,2) or (5,1) puts the board in a 'stuck' state (pegs greyed, a restart tab appears bottom-left) that must be cleared by clicking the bottom-left 16x16 corner
clicking empty floor, the frame or the background clears the selection and its markers (in L1 it also plays a pointing-hand hint); costs 1
the arrows move sliding rail tiles, and L1 has none, so ACTION1/2/3/4 change nothing but each costs 1
undo: restores the board (pegs, selection, markers) to before the previous action AND refunds that action's budget; the visible row-0 bar still advances

goal.note: peg solitaire: capture until exactly ONE green peg remains (5 pegs -> 4 capturing jumps, each a select click plus a marker click = 8 clicks); the level ends on the jump that leaves one peg
